open_points.subject: flow:run_effect_with_approval / Step 6 (grant authority semantics)
open_points.text: State 4 says: "A later send of that node in a run pinned to that version uses the grant as its authority (step 2)." But Step 2 in the same flow says: "a `draft-write` node needs nothing at run time — its authority is the version's FlowActivation — except a resend after `not_applied`; any other class needs ... an approved, unused approval ... or an active grant ..." and State 2 (A10 rule 5) says a grant for `read` or `draft-write` is "never used".
open_points.question: For a granted node whose effect class is `draft-write` (or `read`), which authority must actually be used/recorded at send time?
options: Grant is used for any non-`destructive` node.
`draft-write` uses FlowActivation (except resend after `not_applied`), `read` uses no authority record, and grants on these classes are never used.
open_points.default_guess: Follow A10: do not use a grant for `read`/`draft-write`; use FlowActivation for `draft-write` (except resend after `not_applied`).
